releaseNotes.summary: Juno Beta 0.3 Hotfix 2 polishes the Bot Voice settings layout and separates Bot and Code conversation ownership, so switching surfaces can no longer borrow the other side's conversation.
highlights: Voice settings are rebuilt on scoped field styles and the shared accessible switch, with a layout that holds at narrow window sizes.
Bot and Code keep independent conversation ownership; ordinary mode switching restores each side's own conversation or an honest empty Code state.
Continue in Code is the only explicit handoff: it opens a new Code conversation with bounded references to the Bot transcript and leaves the Bot conversation untouched.
The crash-report notice keeps its full-size dismiss control and no longer collapses into a misaligned stack.
improvements: The Bot conversation menu excludes Code conversations, and the bot subtitle no longer borrows a Code session title.
Code conversations are created with their own record, so creating a Code session no longer moves the Bot's active conversation.
A notification route now returns to Bot before resolving its selection, leaving Code ownership untouched.
fixes: Fixed switching to Code showing the Bot conversation as if it were a Code session.
Fixed creating a Code session silently replacing the Bot's active conversation.
Fixed the crash-report notice actions and close control misaligning when the message wrapped.
knownIssues: The Windows installer remains unsigned; automatic installation of unsigned updates is intentionally disabled.
A live ChatGPT sign-in still needs a real eligible account and owner authorization.
The NSIS installer itself is not executed on this development host to protect the owner's existing Beta installation.
releaseNotes.compatibility: Windows x64. Existing Beta profiles upgrade in place and keep their data, bots and conversations unless the owner explicitly chooses Reset Juno.
